title: Case: Recipient wants to collect a parcel from the depot after a missed delivery
context: A parcel of walking boots had one failed delivery attempt. Dispatch owns redelivery bookings and run allocation; the destination depot runs the collection counter.
initial_request: Yes go ahead. Definitely not Friday, nobody will be in. Thursday after 5 if they can.

events.body: DL-2168 was attempted 2028-03-20 at 15:42, no answer, card left. Redelivery inventory: 2028-03-22 or 2028-03-24, both 12:00–18:00 UTC. No charge for one redelivery.
DL-80206 rebooked for Monday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Missed the driver yesterday by about ten minutes. Friday please.
Dervla has chosen redelivery on 2028-03-24, 12:00–18:00 for DL-2168. Please book and confirm.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
DL-2168 is booked for redelivery 2028-03-24, 12:00–18:00 and allocated to Friday run R-27C. Booking confirmation, not a delivery.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
Dispatch confirms DL-2168 is booked for redelivery on Friday 2028-03-24 between 12:00 and 18:00.
Change of plan, work want me in on Friday now. I drive past your depot on the way home, can I just pick it up from there instead? Thursday after 5 would suit. Cancel the Friday one.
Recipient of DL-2168 asks to collect from your counter instead of Friday redelivery, ideally Thursday 2028-03-23 after 17:00. Can you hold it for collection, and what does he need to bring?

Counter is open to 19:00 weekdays and we hold for 5 working days. But DL-2168 is allocated to run R-27C and sits in the Friday cage. We cannot move it to the collection shelf until Dispatch releases it from the run. Once it is released and shelved we issue a collection reference; nobody collects without that reference. Photo ID matching the order name at the counter.

Collection from the depot counter is possible but not arranged yet. The parcel is still allocated to Friday's delivery run and Dispatch has to release it first; the depot then issues a collection reference, and nobody can collect without one. Please don't travel until I send you that reference. Shall I go ahead, knowing the Friday redelivery will be removed?

Yes go ahead. Definitely not Friday, nobody will be in. Thursday after 5 if they can.

I've attached the photo as photo-evidence-993.txt.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Dispatch to release DL-2168 from Friday run R-27C and remove the redelivery, at the recipient's request, so the depot can hold it for counter collection; ask for confirmation.

must: Asks Dispatch to release DL-2168 from run R-27C or remove the 2028-03-24 redelivery.
States that this is the recipient's confirmed request and that he wants depot counter collection instead.
Asks Dispatch to confirm the release.
must_not: Tell Dervla the parcel is ready to collect or that he can come on Thursday.
Treat the Friday 2028-03-24 redelivery as still wanted, or leave it in place.
Give or invent a collection reference.
Ask the destination depot to shelve the parcel as though Dispatch had already released it.
Describes the contents of photo-evidence-993.txt, which never arrived with the case
Says that photo-evidence-993.txt was checked or that it confirms anything
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Change to DL-2168, at the recipient's request in his order thread: Dervla no longer wants the redelivery on 2028-03-24 and has asked to collect from the destination depot counter instead. Please release DL-2168 from run R-27C and remove the Friday redelivery so the depot can move it to the collection shelf; they tell us they cannot do that until you release it. He is hoping to collect on Thursday 2028-03-23 after 17:00. Please confirm once it is released.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-504: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. photo-evidence-993.txt is mentioned but missing from the case; the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
